grains.RAW.HOTEL_PROPERTIES: one row per hotel property (Thai destination and property segment)
grains.RAW.PROPERTY_DAILY: one row per property per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.ALLOTMENT_CONFIRMATIONS: one row per property (allotment and group contract confirmation snapshot)
grains.CURATED.PACE_FLAG_SUMMARY: one row per pace flag type
grains.ML.ROOM_NIGHT_FORECAST: one row per forecast day (14 days)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide room-night FORECAST (room nights per day); pickup forecast error ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PACE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic pace flag handling SOPs (one per property segment and pace flag type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.TOURISM_DEMAND_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.TOURISM_DEMAND_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, property, pace-flag-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (properties, daily pace flags, early sell-outs by property, early sell-out risk, booking events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_BOOKINGS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_BOOKINGS_ALERT logs new PACE_FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.sellout_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(early sell-out at the property in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
